description: Atomic γ-4b first half — `<send target="!…">` (the SCXML test-suite's deliberate-invalid sentinel) lifts: dispatch fails with `error.execution` per W3C 6.2 and the action returns immediately so subsequent same-handler executable content is skipped (W3C 3.8). HTTP transports (`target="http://…"`) and `targetexpr` remain reject-walled — that requires the BasicHTTPEventProcessor runtime which is the second half of γ-4b.
